name: 呼呼猪
evolution: 呼呼猪 → 獠牙猪 Lv.33
description: 得益于能够分泌疏水性油脂的皮脂腺，皮毛紧实而油亮，既防水又防寒。四肢短而粗壮，跑起来很快，奔跑时偶尔轻微摆动尾巴用来保持平衡。
descriptionEn: Thanks to sebaceous glands that secrete water-repellent oil, its fur is tight and glossy, being both waterproof and cold-resistant. Its limbs are short and stout, yet it runs fast; while running it occasionally swings its tail slightly to keep balance.

skills.name: 丢冰块
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得速度-30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains Speed -30.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains 1 layer of Freeze.

skills.name: 岩脉崩毁
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能能耗固定为4。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; this skill's energy cost is fixed at 4.

skills.name: 地刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when responding to a status: additionally interrupts the responded skill.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains +1 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 砂石冲撞
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，自己获得物防+100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switches this turn, gains Defense +100%.

skills.name: 石锁
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得3回合禁足。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy is immobilized for 3 turns.

skills.name: 冰雹
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外使敌方获得全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when responding to a status: additionally makes the enemy gain +3 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 滚雪球
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层冻结，应对状态：额外获得2层，本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains 2 layers of Freeze; when responding to a status: additionally gains 2 layers, and this skill's power doubles.
